D: Danny's crew head to Europe to pay back the casino owner they robbed, and run into a rival thief.
P: Serve the snacks when the crew lands in Amsterdam.
S: the crew's first stop in Amsterdam
Beef braised with onion and thyme until it falls apart, shredded into a thick roux-based ragout, chilled overnight, rolled into balls, crumbed and fried at 180C. Grainy mustard.
Store-bought caramel waffle biscuits warmed over a cup of hot coffee until soft, stacked, with a dish of extra caramel sauce.
the Night Fox's villa on Lake Como
Bresaola, burrata, figs, grissini and olives on a board, finished with a drizzle of good olive oil and lemon.
M: Carnaroli toasted in butter with onion, white wine, hot stock added ladle by ladle for 18 minutes, saffron steeped in, finished with butter and parmesan.
the Rome leg of the job
Veal or pork escalopes pounded thin, topped with prosciutto and sage, seared in butter, finished with white wine and a knob of butter.
W: Coffee-soaked sponge fingers layered with mascarpone cream and finished with cocoa. Whisk 3 egg yolks with 80g sugar until pale, fold in 500g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream.
K: 60ml orange bitter aperitivo, 90ml prosecco and a splash of soda over ice with an orange slice.

s.note: the crew's first stop in Amsterdam
s.how: Braise 500g beef chuck with an onion and thyme until it falls apart, then shred. Cook 50g butter with 50g flour, add 300ml of the stock and the beef and chill overnight. Roll into balls, crumb in egg and panko and fry at 180C. Serve with grainy mustard.

s.note: the Night Fox's villa on Lake Como
s.how: Lay 100g bresaola on a board with 2 burrata, 4 halved figs, a packet of breadsticks and a bowl of olives. Drizzle with good olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.

m.how: Soften an onion in 30g butter, add 350g carnaroli and toast. Add 125ml white wine, then 1.2L hot stock ladle by ladle for 18 minutes, with a pinch of saffron steeped in. Finish with 40g butter and 60g parmesan.

w.how: Whisk 3 egg yolks with 80g sugar until pale, fold in 500g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip 24 sponge fingers in 300ml cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Chill 4 hours and dust with cocoa.

d.how: For each drink, fill a big wine glass with ice. Add 60ml orange bitter aperitivo, 90ml prosecco and a splash of soda water. Add an orange slice. Makes four.
